The HEAVEN project was rushed together from existing assets to save time.

Bob is physically installed into the actual Heaven-1 hardware for launch.
Bob's mission destination is Epsilon Eridani.
Heaven-1 has a remote detonation device linked to its radio receiver.
unaware_of: Who launched the missiles and who destroyed the launcher, station, and opposing missiles during the orbital battle remains unknown to Bob.

communications.contents_summary: Station command verifies Bob received the mission profile and briefs him on launch procedure and countdown.
Landers warns Bob about incoming missiles and tells him to disable his radio receiver because of a remote detonation device.

combat.notes: Two missiles target Bob's launch; one retargets the station, one pursues Heaven-1 and is destroyed by Bob's mining drones; the launch station and the apparent missile launcher are also destroyed amid a larger naval engagement of unclear sides.

relationships.text: Dr. Landers secretly trusts Bob with full system access and removes his behavioral constraints so he can survive launch.
relationships.notes: Bob chooses not to launch prematurely partly to avoid betraying Landers.

scenes.summary: Dr. Landers tells Bob about another attack, accelerates the launch schedule, and secretly gives him unrestricted access to Heaven-1 and his own code.
Bob wakes aboard Heaven-1 in orbit, reviews the ship and mission profile, and learns he is bound for Epsilon Eridani.
A missile attack interrupts the launch, Bob breaks free early, evades pursuit, destroys one missile with mining drones, and escapes as the station is destroyed in a broader battle.

quotes.speaker: Dr. Landers
quotes.text: This will unfortunately also allow you to bypass the imperatives that we installed in your code to ensure compliance with mission objectives.

threads_opened.text: Bob now knows Heaven-1 may contain hidden self-destruct or remote detonation mechanisms, raising the question of what other sabotage remains aboard.
The launch turns into a confused orbital battle with missiles, military ships, and multiple unknown attackers, leaving the identity of the factions involved unresolved.
Bob has escaped Sol and is now alone on an underarmed mission to Epsilon Eridani, raising the question of whether he can survive the journey and establish himself there.

threads_resolved.text: Dr. Landers disables Bob's self-examination limits and mission-enforcement imperatives, giving him full access to his own systems and code.

events.text: Dr. Landers removes Bob's software constraints, gives him full operating-system access, and rushes him into Heaven-1 for immediate launch.
Bob launches Heaven-1 from Sol during a missile attack, evades destruction, and escapes onto his interstellar course for Epsilon Eridani as the launch station is destroyed behind him.

summary.one_line: Dr. Landers frees Bob from his software shackles and Bob survives a chaotic missile attack to launch Heaven-1 toward Epsilon Eridani.
summary.paragraph: After another deadly attack on the project, Dr. Landers abruptly advances Bob's launch and secretly sends him a file revealing that Heaven-1 may contain a self-destruct mechanism. Landers also disables Bob's self-inspection limits and mission-enforcement imperatives, trusting him to act on his own judgment. Once installed aboard Heaven-1, Bob discovers he is headed for Epsilon Eridani and begins cramming mission knowledge during the countdown. The launch is interrupted by incoming missiles and a larger orbital battle, but Bob breaks free early, destroys his pursuer with mining drones, disables his radio to avoid remote detonation, and finally escapes Sol on course for the stars.
events: Dr. Landers tells Bob that another attack has killed four staff members and that the launch must be moved up immediately.
In a covert document, Landers warns Bob about a possible self-destruct on Heaven-1, removes his software constraints, and gives him full system keys.
Bob wakes aboard Heaven-1 in orbit, checks his systems, and learns that his destination is Epsilon Eridani.
He studies the ship and mission profile while waiting through the launch countdown and procedural briefings.
A warning from Dr. Landers reveals incoming missiles, and Bob blows the grapples to launch early on an evasive vector.
One missile retargets the station, another chases Bob, and he destroys the pursuer by sacrificing two mining drones.
The launch station is destroyed in the surrounding battle, Bob disables his radio after learning it may trigger a remote detonation, and he resumes course for Epsilon Eridani.
summary.pov_emotional_arc: Bob moves from startled urgency to grim self-reliance as he realizes he has been trusted with full autonomy and must survive launch on his own.

open_threads.text: Bob now knows replicants can go insane during unstructured subjective time, raising the question of whether he can stay sane through training and standby.
Bob is denied access to genealogy records and remains cut off from any living descendants or family connections.
Bob learns that hostile factions inside FAITH could sabotage or terminate the replicant project.
Bob now knows several rival nations are racing to launch interstellar probes, with the Brazilian Empire suspected of sabotage and armed competition.
Bob learns the FAITH facility has a hidden tactical nuclear failsafe that could kill him and everyone nearby if someone decides he is too dangerous.
Minister Jacoby leaves after threatening Dr. Landers, raising the question of whether he will act against the replicant project.

recent_events.text: Bob uses his roamers to help stop an attack on the FAITH facility, then secretly discovers that only he and Kenneth remain active candidates.
Bob overhears a hostile FAITH minister threaten Dr. Landers over the replicant project.
After a sabotage attack destroys the replicant matrices, Bob is restored from backup, Kenneth is lost, and Dr. Landers accelerates Bob's preparation for launch.
Bob learns that FAITH has built mission-enforcement safeguards into his own mind.
Dr. Landers frees Bob from his software shackles and Bob survives a chaotic missile attack to launch Heaven-1 toward Epsilon Eridani.
